text:
Trevor Connelly went 19th overall in 2024 and spent last season in the AHL. Now, at 20, he is one of the best things about the Golden Knights. He has 15 points in 24 games playing under 15 minutes a night, and among skaters only 35 have added more wins with their goals this season by our count.

This doesn't look like a hot streak. Vegas gets 61% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on, nearly ten points better than without him, and his shooting is right at league average. EDGE tracking has his top skating speed in the 99th percentile. The Athletic's Jesse Granger described the setup he made on Nov. 17: he "faked the shot to get Oettinger to bite, then fed Karlsson for a one-timer."

He has three assists in the last two games, both overtime or shootout losses to Dallas, and scored his shootout attempt on Nov. 19. Forwards drafted where he was typically score 0.36 points a game in their first full season; he's at 0.62. The obvious question during this four-game skid is whether he earns more than 15 minutes.
headline: Connelly is Vegas's best rookie story
